policy: Status i32: 0 success, 1 invalid argument/type, 2 range, 3 allocation failure, 4 missing, 5 encoding, 6 parse, 7 I/O, 8 EOF, 9 limit. Outputs unchanged on failure except documented progress. Output storage must be valid, nonnull and disjoint from inputs and handle storage. Byte spans must be initialized and <= INT64_MAX bytes; null is allowed only for empty spans. Handles must be live and nonnull except destroy/close. Handles and views are borrowed unless stated owned. Invalid/dangling pointers remain undefined behavior. Container fields are private. Mutation invalidates byte views and iterators; JSON node handles last until document destruction. No internal synchronization.

modules.name: std_core
modules.summary: Statuses, shared types and recoverable allocation.
functions: Borrowed static NUL-terminated English description; unknown codes return unknown status.
Owned zero-initialized allocation, checked product <= INT64_MAX. Zero bytes still return a freeable base. Release with std_core_release.
Release an owned allocation base, or null.
Grow owned allocation geometrically; preserve data and capacity on failure. New storage is uninitialized. Invalidates views when growth occurs.
Configured default file byte limit; whole-file API takes an explicit limit.
Configured replacement for a zero RNG seed.

modules.name: std_bytes
modules.summary: Byte spans and owned growable buffers.
functions: Lexicographic unsigned byte comparison returns -1, 0, or 1, not status. Null spans allowed only at zero length.
First matching byte index; empty needle matches zero; missing returns 4. Null spans allowed only when empty.
Overlap-safe byte copy; range status if len exceeds capacity; null allowed for zero length.
Create an owned empty buffer; destroy with std_bytes_destroy.
Destroy buffer and owned bytes; accepts null.
Ensure at least capacity bytes; length unchanged; failure preserves contents.
Append span; self-append and interior spans supported. Failure preserves contents. No implicit NUL byte.
Set length to zero, retain capacity.
Return borrowed bytes and length; mutation or destruction invalidates the view.

modules.name: std_text
modules.summary: UTF-8 scalars, ASCII transforms and decimal integers.
functions: Decode one Unicode scalar and advance byte index on success. EOF at len; encoding error leaves outputs unchanged.
Validate complete UTF-8, including overlong encodings, surrogates and scalar range.
In-place ASCII A-Z conversion; all other bytes unchanged.
In-place ASCII a-z conversion; all other bytes unchanged.
Parse complete decimal integer with optional minus. No whitespace or plus. Empty/invalid returns parse; overflow returns range.
Parse complete unsigned decimal digits; no sign or whitespace. Overflow returns range.
Append decimal representation, atomically on failure.
Append unsigned decimal representation, atomically on failure.

modules.name: std_vec
functions: Reserve elements without changing length; failure preserves contents.
Insert at index <= length, shifting subsequent elements.
Remove checked index and return removed value.
In-place ascending signed sort, no allocation.
First equal index in ascending sorted vector; missing returns 4.

modules.name: std_map
modules.summary: Owned byte-key/i64 map; iteration order unspecified.
functions: Destroy map and copied keys; null accepted.
Insert copied key or replace value; empty keys allowed; failure preserves map.
Lookup exact byte key; missing returns 4.
Delete key, freeing its storage; missing returns 4.
Start cursor at zero; returns borrowed key, value and advances cursor. EOF returns 8. Mutation invalidates iteration.

modules.name: std_math
modules.summary: Checked i64 arithmetic and f64 libm operations.
functions: Checked signed addition; overflow returns range.
Checked signed subtraction; overflow returns range.
Checked signed multiplication; overflow returns range.
System libm square root; IEEE NaN/infinity results, no status/errno API.

modules.name: std_random
functions: Initialize caller storage; zero maps to configured nonzero seed.
Advance initialized generator with shifts 12,25,27 and multiplier 2685821657736338717.
Unbiased result in [0,bound); zero bound returns invalid without advancing state.
One generator draw per byte, taking low eight bits; empty span permitted.
OS getrandom bytes, retry EINTR. On I/O failure data may be partially filled; never fall back to deterministic RNG.

modules.name: std_io
modules.summary: Synchronous POSIX file and console I/O.
functions: Owned file; length-delimited path rejects embedded NUL. Modes 0 read, 1 create/truncate, 2 create/append. Destroy with close.
Consume file even on close failure; null succeeds. Do not retry.
Read up to capacity, retry EINTR. EOF reports 8 with count zero; zero capacity succeeds. Other failures leave count unchanged.
Write complete span, retry EINTR; count reports bytes written even on I/O failure.
Read bounded whole file into owned buffer. Over limit returns 9; output unchanged on failure.
Create/truncate and write complete file. Failure may leave partial external file contents.
Write complete stdout span, retry EINTR. No newline or NUL appended.
Write complete stderr span, retry EINTR.

modules.name: std_time
functions: CLOCK_REALTIME signed nanoseconds since Unix epoch; may move backwards.
Checked end minus start; backwards interval returns range.
Sleep for duration, retry interruption; platform error returns I/O.

modules.name: std_json
modules.summary: Owned JSON documents, borrowed nodes, strict parsing and bounded serialization.
functions: Create owned empty document with no root.
Destroy document and every allocated node/view; null accepted.
Parse one complete JSON value; depth 0 uses default. Reject duplicate object keys, invalid UTF-8, unpaired surrogates, trailing data. Preserve number lexemes. Owned document output.
Borrowed root, or null for empty document.
Kind, not status: 0 null, 1 false, 2 true, 3 number, 4 string, 5 array, 6 object.
Borrow decoded string or original number lexeme; other kinds return invalid.
Checked conversion of number lexeme containing only decimal integer syntax; fractions/exponents return parse.
Borrow exact object member; missing returns 4, wrong kind returns invalid.
Borrow checked array element; out-of-range returns 2.
Create detached document-owned node. String input is decoded UTF-8; number is validated lexeme; other kinds require empty span. Node budget enforced.
Set detached node from same document as root. Previous root remains document-owned and becomes detached.
Attach detached same-document node to array; reject cycles and root attachment.
Copy UTF-8 key and attach detached same-document node. Replace existing member; old value becomes detached, still document-owned. Reject cycles.
Serialize compact JSON into owned buffer, preserving number lexemes and insertion order. Depth 0 uses default. Enforce explicit output-byte limit.
Serialize exactly this borrowed subtree into owned buffer, without mutating its document or including siblings/object-member key. Null returns invalid. Same limits and formatting as stringify.

modules.name: std_net
modules.summary: Owned nonblocking TCP sockets and readiness polling; no DNS or TLS.
functions: Listen on IPv4/IPv6 literal or localhost (IPv4 loopback), port 0..65535. Owned socket, nonblocking and close-on-exec. IPv6 is v6-only.
Success returns owned nonblocking socket, or null when no client is ready. Output unchanged on failure.
Begin nonblocking connection to literal/localhost. Success returns owned socket; poll writable then call connected, including for immediately connected sockets.
After writable readiness, check SO_ERROR; returns success or I/O. Does not consume socket.
One nonblocking receive, retry EINTR. Success count zero means would-block (or zero capacity); EOF returns 8 with count zero. Other failures preserve count.
One nonblocking send with SIGPIPE suppressed; may send a prefix. Success count zero means would-block or empty span. Failures preserve count.

Caller-owned initialized array: socket may be null to ignore; events bits 1 readable, 2 writable. Replaces ready with bits 1 readable, 2 writable, 4 hangup/error. Nonnegative timeout; timeout or EINTR succeeds with ready zero. Other failures preserve ready fields.
Consume owned socket even on close failure. Null succeeds; do not retry.

modules.name: std_process
modules.summary: Native arguments, executable path and scoped shutdown signals.
functions: Borrow argv[index] as bytes without its NUL; requires native main argc/argv. Checked index; bytes last for process lifetime unless caller mutates argv.
Owned executable path bytes from /proc/self/exe, no NUL.
Own process-wide SIGINT/SIGTERM handler scope. Only one live scope allowed; handlers only set sig_atomic_t flag. Must be used from a single-threaded host.
True after SIGINT or SIGTERM in the live scope.
Restore previous handlers and consume scope; null accepted.

modules.name: std_http
modules.summary: Incremental bounded HTTP/1 request parser and close-delimited response construction in LM0.
functions: Owned parser. Positive header byte/count limits; body may be zero. Checked combined limit <= INT64_MAX. Destroy with destroy.
Destroy parser and its owned request bytes; null accepted.
Discard request/error, retain limits and allocated capacity; invalidates views.

Append fragment; success sets ready when entire request is available. No further feed after completion/error until reset. Parse/limit failure is sticky; error accessor gives HTTP code. Allocation failure permits retry without consuming fragment. Strict CRLF, origin-form target, HTTP/1.0 or 1.1, no transfer encoding, no duplicate Host/Content-Length, no Expect. Bytes beyond one request are ignored by consumers; no pipelining support. Views borrowed until next feed/reset/destroy.
HTTP status for parser failure, zero otherwise; not a library status.
Requires complete request; 1 GET, 2 POST, 3 other. Not a status.
Requires complete request; borrow origin-form target including query string.
Requires complete request; borrow exactly Content-Length bytes; missing length means zero.
Requires complete request; case-insensitive name lookup, trim SP/HTAB around first matching value. Missing returns 4. Duplicate framing, Origin and Content-Type headers are rejected by parser.

Complete request for a plain HTTP server: absent Origin is accepted. Otherwise require http:// authority matching Host, case-insensitive host and numeric port (default 80). Reject null, userinfo, paths, whitespace, malformed ports and unbracketed IPv6. Equivalent IPv6 spellings are not normalized.
Complete request Content-Type is application/json, case-insensitive, optionally followed by semicolon parameters. Missing or another media type is false.

Owned HTTP/1.1 response with status, Content-Length and Connection: close. headers is a trusted CRLF-terminated header block supplied by application (no blank line, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding or Connection); body may be binary. Explicit total byte limit. Caller must use fixed/validated header values, never raw request data.
